title: Sleepy pig
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#f2a0b5'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='80' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#d97a94'/>
  <rect x='60' y='80' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#d97a94'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#f7b8c9'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M30 26 L26 12 L42 22 Z' fill='#e88aa5'/>
  <path d='M70 26 L74 12 L58 22 Z' fill='#e88aa5'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eyes -->
  <path d='M36 40 Q41 45 46 40' fill='none' stroke='#8c4a5e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 40 Q59 45 64 40' fill='none' stroke='#8c4a5e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#f19ab3'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#a85e72'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#a85e72'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ec7f9c'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='50' r='4' fill='#ec7f9c'/>
  <!-- curly tail -->
  <path d='M79 70 q10 -4 6 -10 q-5 -6 -8 -1' fill='none' stroke='#d97a94' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
